faq.sousTitreSection: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.q1: How do I pay for a course?
faq.r1: You can pay directly on the platform using MonCash today. NatCash will be available soon.
faq.q2: How do I get access after payment?
faq.r2: Once payment is validated, access to all course lessons is unlocked instantly on your account.
faq.q3: Can I watch courses on my mobile phone?

faq.q5: How can I get help if I run into an issue?

confidentialite.sousTitre: How we process, protect, and use your data on the BAYONDY platform.
confidentialite.s1_texte: The BAYONDY platform offers online video courses in Haitian Creole. The legal entity and address are:
confidentialite.s2_compte: Account data: When registering, we use your name, email, profile picture (if Google login), and timestamps.
confidentialite.s2_progression: Learning data: We record your active course enrollments, completed lessons, and last viewed lesson.
confidentialite.s2_paiement: Payment data: We only retain the transaction reference, amount, currency, selected payment method, and timestamp.
confidentialite.s3_texte: This data is strictly used to: create and manage your account, grant access to purchased courses, track your learning progress, and verify payments.
confidentialite.s4_firebase: Firebase / Google Cloud: For secure authentication and database storage.
confidentialite.s4_paiement: Payment processor: For secure payment processing (to be confirmed based on the selected platform).
confidentialite.s4_youtube: YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com): For video streaming. The player loads only after your explicit click.
confidentialite.s4_vercel: Vercel: For hosting the web application.
confidentialite.s5_texte: BAYONDY never sees or stores your secret PIN codes or full credit card numbers. Payments are processed directly by our third-party payment processor. Retention details for the selected processor:
confidentialite.s6_texte: Your account and course data are stored as long as your account remains active. Exact retention timeframe:
confidentialite.s7_texte: You have the right to access, rectify, or request deletion of your personal data. Procedure to exercise your rights:
confidentialite.s8_texte: We do not use any advertising cookies or trackers. Only your Firebase Auth sign-in session is stored locally in your browser.
confidentialite.s9_texte: The platform is intended for users of legal age to contract and use online services. Policy regarding minors:
confidentialite.s10_texte: This policy may be updated periodically. Last updated date:

conditions.sousTitre: Rules and commitments governing the use of the BAYONDY platform.
conditions.s1_texte: BAYONDY provides online video training in Haitian Creole. Access is reserved for registered users who have completed their payment.
conditions.s2_texte: Each account is strictly personal. You agree to provide accurate information and keep your credentials confidential.
conditions.s3_texte: Prices are displayed in gourdes (HTG) or dollars (USD). Access is granted once payment is confirmed by the server. Course access duration:
conditions.s4_texte: Conditions and terms for refund requests:
conditions.s5_texte: It is strictly forbidden to copy, download, resell, or share video links with third parties. Content is for your personal use only.
conditions.s6_texte: All content, videos, texts, logos, and materials remain the exclusive property of BAYONDY or their respective authors.
conditions.s7_texte: In the event of a breach of these rules (such as link sharing or hacking attempts), access may be suspended or revoked without notice.
conditions.s8_texte: The service is provided 'as is'. We strive to maintain high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Courses do not guarantee employment or financial outcomes.
